sloka: सर्वसत्वानि यानीह स्थावराणि चराणि च ।महता पांसुवर्षेण विलयं सर्वतो ऽगमन् ।। ७.८१.९ ॥
transliteration: sarvasatvāni yānīha sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca ।mahatā pāṁsuvarṣeṇa vilayaṁ sarvato 'gaman ।। 7.81.9 ॥

translations.english: All beings, both mobile and immobile, present in that region, completely met their destruction due to the great shower of dust.
